title: introduce-temporal-rbac-windows-kms-auth-proxy-and-audit-compactor
author: Asha Mehta
release_notes:
- Add RBAC v2 temporal constraints (time/window-based policies) for operator and service roles.
- Introduce KMS authorization proxy that validates region claims and signs challenge tokens.
- Compact audit envelope writer with reservoir sampling to reduce egress for high-frequency tenants.
description: Summary: This PR introduces three coordinated features to strengthen residency and access controls without requiring a platform-wide migration: 1) a lightweight temporal extension to RBAC v2 that allows teams to express role grants with time windows (daily windows, UTC offsets, and adhoc maintenance windows), 2) a KMS authorization proxy that enforces region claim pinning and issues short-lived HMAC-backed authorization tokens for downstream services, and 3) an audit compactor that produces compact, signed audit envelopes and applies reservoir sampling for very high-volume tenants to keep audit storage and egress bounded. Motivation: Customers asked for more expressive policies (time-bound approvals for operator tasks, on-call windows, and maintenance-only roles), and security requested stronger proof that KMS usage respects the tenant region claim before allowing encrypt/decrypt operations. The audit compaction responds to rising costs for customers with extremely chatty telemetry. What changed: - pkg/rbac/temporal.go: new temporal rule parser and evaluator; integrates with existing RBAC decision path only when temporal constraints are present. - internal/kms/proxy/handler.go: KMS authorization proxy that validates origin claims, applies allowlists, and produces signed short-lived tokens consumed by the KMS client libraries. - pkg/audit/compactor.go: envelope compactor that batches audit events, computes a Merkle-like rolling hash for integrity, and exposes a compact envelope format. - cmd/installer/templates/role_migration.yaml: optional operator-facing migration helper to preview temporal effects. - sdk/common/kms_client.go: small integration that switches from direct KMS calls to using the proxy when tenant has region-pin enabled. - tests/*: unit and integration test suites for temporal rules, proxy flow, and audit compactness. Backwards compatibility: Temporal rules are opt-in. If no temporal conditions exist, RBAC decision path is identical to today. KMS proxy is enabled per-tenant via a new tenant flag; clients fallback to current behavior if not enabled. Audit compactor is behind a feature flag and only applies sampling for tenants configured with the new audit profile. Migration notes: - Admins can dry-run temporal rules using the role_migration.yaml template. - To enable KMS proxy, update tenant config: kms_proxy: enabled, kms_allowed_regions: [..]. - Existing tenants do not change unless they opt in. Testing done: - Unit tests: temporal parser (edge-case DST windows, leap-second tolerant), RBAC integration tests with existing policy fixtures. - Integration tests: end-to-end KMS proxy flow in the integration cluster (auth handshake, signed token acceptance by fake-kms). - Load test: audit compactor measured at 20k events/sec with reservoir sampling thresholds, reduced egress by ~87% for a synthetic noisy tenant. - Security review: threat model updated, proxy threat mitigations (signature validation, nonce replay protection) added. Checklist: - [x] Spec reviewed with security (SEC-314) - [x] Linear tasks created and linked - [x] Unit/integration tests added - [x] Feature flags gated for staged rollout - [x] Monitoring and alerts added for proxy error rates and compactor queue length Rollout plan: 1) Merge behind feature flags. 2) Enable audit compactor for internal noisy tenant and monitor. 3) Offer KMS proxy to opt-in enterprise tenants for a pilot. 4) Gradually add migration tooling for temporal rules and document operator UX in the Console. Observability: Added metrics: rbac.temporal.evals, kmsproxy.requests_total (by region-claim), kmsproxy.signature_failures, audit.compactor.batch_size, audit.compactor.sampling_rate. Tracing hooks were added to the proxy and compactor and connected to the existing distributed-trace sampler. Security considerations: - KMS proxy only accepts TLS mutual auth from known control-plane nodes. - Proxy signs tokens with an ephemeral HMAC key rotated every 6 hours; verification uses KMS-managed public proof. - Audit envelopes include integrity hashes and can be replay-checked during retention verification. Open items: - Discuss UI/Console representation of temporal windows with Product. - Decide default reservoir size for high-volume tenants; current default 1k/sec reservoir with 5% deterministic tail retention. - Add a migration job to annotate existing role bindings with 'temporal: none' for clarity. See commits and changed files below.
commits: Add temporal RBAC parser and evaluator (pkg/rbac/temporal.go)
Introduce KMS auth proxy and handler (internal/kms/proxy/handler.go)
Installer template for previewing temporal impact (cmd/installer/templates/role_migration.yaml)
SDK switch to optionally use KMS proxy (sdk/common/kms_client.go)
Integration tests and CI config updates
review_comments: Jonah Reyes: Can the temporal evaluator express recurring maintenance windows across different timezones? We need to ensure policy authoring remains simple. Requested: add examples in docs.
Asha Mehta (author): Reply: yes — we expose UTC-based windows and an optional timezone offset. Added examples in docs/security/temporal-rbac.md and extra unit tests for offsets.

Maya Chen: The proxy key rotation frequency is aggressive; can we align with our existing 6h rotation plan and document failure modes? Also please add an integration test that simulates replay attempts.
Asha Mehta: Adjusted rotation to 6h, added replay nonce store with TTL and a regression test that replays a token and expects rejection.
Eric Bauer: Observability wise, add SLI/SLO suggestions for kmsproxy and compactor queue depth. Also watch for memory pressure when compactor batches large tenant bursts.
Asha Mehta: Added metrics, alerts and a throttling fallback in compactor to spill to cold storage if memory crosses threshold.
Jonah Reyes: CI flake on first run (lint error for style). Minor comment about an exported function name, raised small change requested.
Asha Mehta: Fixed lint and renamed exported function; re-ran CI.
ci_checks: ci/e2e: pass (flaky flagged but within threshold)
notes_on_merge: Merged after approvals from Maya Chen and Jonah Reyes. Feature-gated; requires tenant opt-in and operations rollout.
post_merge_tasks: Add Console UI for temporal role preview (follow-up ENG-1492)
Pilot KMS proxy with two enterprise tenants and collect metrics
Create runbook for audit compactor high-memory behavior
changelist_summary: Introduces opt-in temporal constraints to RBAC v2, a KMS authorization proxy enforcing region claims and issuing short-lived signed tokens, and an audit envelope compactor that reduces storage/egress for noisy tenants. All features are behind toggles and covered by unit/integration tests.
